description: July 10 birthday meaning: Cancer decan 2, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 10 birthday falls in Cancer, in the second decan, with Moon as the sign's ruler and Pluto as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Cancer is cardinal and water.

sections.heading: The July 10 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: July 10th reduces to the independent 1 and places the Sun eighteen degrees into Cancer. Pluto, sub-ruling this decan, lends intensity to the Crab's protectiveness, while the 1 adds self-direction. The traditional portrait is of a quiet force: not loud, but resolved, someone who decides privately and then pursues the goal with remarkable persistence.

Astronomically, July 10 puts the Sun near 18° Cancer in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Pluto. In the middle of Cancer, from 10 to 19 degrees, the sub-ruler is Pluto, the modern ruler of Scorpio. That brings an intensity to the Crab's tenderness. Early-July birthdays are often linked with emotional depth, loyalty that runs very deep, and a sharp instinct for what goes unsaid in a room. These Cancerians tend to protect privately and completely, sometimes keeping their own needs hidden behind the shell. Pluto adds resilience and a capacity for real renewal after loss. Learning to trust selectively, rather than all or nothing, usually helps the intensity become a source of steadiness instead of strain.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for July 10
paragraphs: A birthday on the 10th is a compound: 1 + 0 = 1. In Pythagorean numerology this is read as a 1 with a 0 attached, and the 0 is often described as amplifying whatever stands beside it. So the 10th carries the independence and initiative of the 1, with an added sense of potential and of cycles completing and restarting. People born on this day are frequently portrayed as self-reliant and adaptable, able to begin again after setbacks. The day number is secondary to the Life Path, but here it often shows as a quiet, practical resilience.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a July 10 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous July 10 birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 10 is the 191st day of the year (192nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Leo, is usually complete within 13 days, by July 23.

By July 10 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a July 10 birthday are Nikola Tesla (1856), Marcel Proust (1871) and Alice Munro (1931).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 10?
faq.answer: July 10 is Cancer in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Cancer, which tradition links with Pluto.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 10?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 10 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 10th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 10?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 10, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 10?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on July 10 include Nikola Tesla (1856), Marcel Proust (1871) and Alice Munro (1931). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
